prompts.teaser: Use case: scientific-educational / illustration-story. This is a generated ART-DIRECTION REFERENCE, never experimental evidence. Tell a compelling visual story like an elegant science film poster, but clean enough to reproduce at 5.5 inches. The subject is visual world-model forecasting for a robot manipulating objects. On the left, a large recognizable premium camera with dimensional lens and a beautifully composed miniature tabletop manipulation scene: two understated robot grippers, one simple object and an observation frame. Show a clearly physical recorded-evidence layer, then transition into spatial feature objects: translucent layered patch surfaces with meaningful retained source identity, depth, carefully controlled highlights and luminous material, not generic flat checkerboard tiles or rows of rounded boxes. Across the middle/right, visibly contrast two possible futures: an upper restrained warm-coral autoregressive cascade where each imagined FEATURE object becomes the source for the next, and a stronger lower cobalt/teal branch where the SAME original observed reference supports several future FEATURE hypotheses through an elegant fixed-source fanout. Do not depict imagined states as real video frames; make future objects unmistakably abstract latent feature surfaces. The fixed-source relationship should dominate the first glance. Make the lower branch visually reveal a small local patch mixture plus a separate bounded correction, without a mathematical flowchart or new fictional modules. Include three tiny secondary scene-card placeholders near an edge to suggest different tabletop datasets; keep these clearly stylized example illustrations and subordinate to the main story, not a photo contact-sheet wall. Leave the entire bottom 18 percent as a clean white evidence band for later source-backed numerical overlay: ABSOLUTELY NO numbers, percentage badges, curves, plots, performance marks or invented results. Palette: deep navy structure, rich cobalt blue, balanced teal, warm coral and a little amber, white negative space. Visually rich selective depth, premium editorial lighting, subtle realistic shadows, no dark background, no neon/cyberpunk glow, no rainbow. Minimal typography, only the optional short labels 'Observed', 'Autoregressive', 'Fixed reference'. No title, subtitle, paragraphs, tiny labels, decorative logos or borders. Every primary connection continuous and legible, no tangled arrows. Output one polished composition image, not multiple alternatives or a collage of posters.
